notes.title: The remake of Memories Under the Winter Tree (1.5) is now available!
notes.content:
The remake of Memories Under the Winter Tree (1.5) is now available!

May this winter cold, snow dance in the air to spread good news, fluttering angels, with the arrival of winter to descend blessing.

- Game UI optimization and engine change.
- Added support for macOS and Linux in addition to Windows.
- New achievement system
- Full text optimization (including plot reconstruction and story improvement)
- Partial (7 pictures) CG reset and renovation
- Added the function of jumping to the corresponding history dialog
- Increased the number of archives, and added a new thank you list option
- New route endings and 5 new CGs.
- New PV (Chinese OP)

At the same time, we have opened the Second Creation event and the preview of the 3rd Anniversary Peripheral in the bilibii community, if you are interested or want to know more details, welcome to follow the official bilibii account:
https://space.bilibili.com/286892605

Special thanks, all players who have sponsored or supported the purchase of peripherals can apply for a thank you list collection form:
https://docs.qq.com/form/page/DSmNXakRvdGhrUEJv
Expected to be updated around February 2, 2025 within the game's thank you list.

MagicaLuv

notes.title: 《冬日树下的回忆》重制版(1.5)更新预定！
notes.content:
亲爱的sensei，
在这段共同走过的旅程中，衷心感谢您一直以来对《冬日树下的回忆》不离不弃的支持与厚爱。从最初的萌芽到如今的小有成就，每一步都凝聚着您们的热情与期待。

回望过去，《冬日树下的回忆》诞生于一个简单的想法，由主催一人孤军奋战，因此在早期的版本中，可能给部分玩家带来了不尽如人意的体验。对此，深感歉意，并深知是玩家们的宽容与鼓励，让这份自娱自乐的创作得以绽放光彩，吸引了众多新朋友的加入。这份意外的收获，既让我们惊喜，也让我们深感责任重大。

时隔一年半之久，决定以全新的姿态回馈大家的厚爱，正式宣布《冬日树下的回忆》1.5版本将于3周年上线（12月）。
这是一次全面的翻新与重置，游戏依然免费向所有玩家开放，并带来以下重大更新：

1. 游戏UI演出翻新、引擎更换。
2. 全文本优化。
3. 部分CG重置翻新。
4. 新增跳转到对应历史对话功能。
5. 存档数增加，并新增感谢名单选项。
6.新增二周目(小忆)全新线路结局，并添加5张全新CG。
7.全新中文版OP

诚挚邀请ensei，今年圣诞，再次体验与天使们的日常生活！

感谢您的游览

《冬日树下的回忆》作者
